text: Pabeidziet sakāmvārdu: „Kas otram bedri rok, …”
gloss: Finish the proverb: "Whoever digs a pit for another…" — "…falls into it himself": «Kas otram bedri rok, pats iekrīt».

text: Ja vārdā „kazas” pirmajam „a” uzliek garumzīmi, ko nozīmē jaunais vārds?
gloss: Put a macron on the first "a" of "kazas" (goats): what does the new word mean? — A celebration: "kāzas" is a wedding. One macron changes the word.

text: Kādu ziedu pēc tautas ticējuma meklē Jāņu naktī, lai gan šis augs patiesībā nemaz nezied?
gloss: Which flower do people seek on Midsummer night by folk belief, though the plant never blooms? — The fern flower; ferns reproduce by spores. Oak, linden and birch all flower.

text: Kurā dienā Latvijā svin valsts proklamēšanas gadadienu?
gloss: On which day does Latvia celebrate the anniversary of its proclamation? — 18 November (1918). 4 May is the restoration of independence, 11 November is Lāčplēsis Day, 23 June is Līgo.

text: Kuru latviešu tautas mūzikas instrumentu spēlē, ar pirkstiem strinkšķinot stīgas?
gloss: Which Latvian folk instrument is played by plucking strings with the fingers? — The kokle (zither). Dūdas are bagpipes, stabule a pipe, trideksnis a jingle percussion.

text: Hokejā uz ledus katrai komandai ir seši spēlētāji, ieskaitot vārtsargu. Par cik spēlētājiem vairāk parastā spēles brīdī ir futbola laukumā?
gloss: In ice hockey each team has six players on the ice, goalie included. How many more players are on a football pitch? — 10: football 2 × 11 = 22, hockey 2 × 6 = 12.

text: Latvijai uz sauszemes ir četras kaimiņvalstis. Kura no šīm valstīm nav starp tām?
gloss: Latvia has four land neighbours. Which of these is not one of them? — Poland: it borders Lithuania, not Latvia. The four are Estonia, Lithuania, Belarus, Russia.

text: Animācijas filmā „Ratatouille” žurka Remijs kļūst par pavāru. Kurā pilsētā notiek darbība?
gloss: In "Ratatouille" the rat Remy becomes a chef. In which city? — Paris (Gusteau's restaurant).

text: Kurš no šiem dzīvniekiem ziemu pārguļ ziemas miegā?
gloss: Which of these animals hibernates through winter? — The hedgehog. Hares, foxes and roe deer stay active all winter.

text: No rīta termometrs rādīja −5 °C, bet līdz pusdienlaikam kļuva par 8 grādiem siltāks. Cik grādu termometrs rāda pusdienlaikā?
gloss: In the morning it was −5 °C, by noon 8 degrees warmer. What is the temperature at noon? — 3 °C: −5 + 8. The others catch sign slips.

text: Ko dara cilvēks, par kuru saka, ka viņš „pūš pīlītes”?
gloss: What is a person doing who "blows little ducks"? — Lying / telling tall tales: the idiom «pūst pīlītes».

text: Kurš no šiem vārdiem, ievērojot arī garumzīmes, lasāms vienādi no abām pusēm?
gloss: Which word, counting macrons too, reads the same both ways? — "sēdēs" (will sit): s-ē-d-ē-s. "sēdās" and "sākas" fail only on a macron; "nesēs" reverses to "sēsen".

text: Zibens uzzibsnīja, un pērkons atskanēja pēc 9 sekundēm. Skaņa gaisā sekundē veic aptuveni 340 metrus. Cik tālu ir negaiss?
gloss: Lightning flashed, thunder came 9 seconds later; sound travels about 340 m per second. How far is the storm? — About 3 km: 9 × 340 ≈ 3,060 m. "9 km" catches autopilot.

text: Latīņu alfabētā ir 26 burti. Latviešu alfabētā nav burtu q, w, x un y, toties ir vienpadsmit burtu ar diakritiskajām zīmēm. Cik burtu ir latviešu alfabētā?
gloss: The Latin alphabet has 26 letters; Latvian drops q, w, x, y but adds eleven letters with diacritics. How many letters? — 33: 26 − 4 + 11 (ā č ē ģ ī ķ ļ ņ š ū ž).

text: Saule, ko redzam debesīs, patiesībā ir neliels „vēstures ieraksts”. Cik ilgi tās gaisma ceļo līdz Zemei?
gloss: The Sun we see is a small "recording of the past". How long does its light take to reach Earth? — About 8 minutes (about 8 min 20 s for 150 million km).

text: Kad Rīgā pulkstenis rāda 12.00, cik tas rāda Londonā?
gloss: When it is 12:00 in Riga, what time is it in London? — 10:00: Latvia is two hours ahead of the UK all year (both switch to summer time on the same dates). Needs the time zones and the direction.

text: Romānu „Mērnieku laiki” sarakstīja divi autori kopā. Kas viņi bija?
gloss: The novel "The Times of the Land Surveyors" was written by two authors together. Who? — The brothers Reinis and Matīss Kaudzīte (1879). The other pairs are real but never co-wrote a novel.

text: Kurš izpildītājs 2002. gadā izcīnīja Latvijai uzvaru Eirovīzijas dziesmu konkursā?
gloss: Who won Eurovision for Latvia in 2002? — Marie N (Marija Naumova) with "I Wanna". Prāta Vētra came third in 2000; Aisha sang in 2010.

text: Gints Zilbalodis ar animācijas filmu „Straume” izcīnīja Latvijai pirmo „Oskaru”. Kurš dzīvnieks ir filmas galvenais varonis?
gloss: Gints Zilbalodis won Latvia's first Oscar with the animated film "Flow". Which animal is its hero? — A (black) cat. Best Animated Feature, 2025.

text: Kāda profesija ir Nintendo spēļu varonim Mario?
gloss: What is Nintendo's Mario by trade? — A plumber.

text: Jāsamaksā tieši 3,88 € tikai ar eiro monētām. Kāds ir mazākais monētu skaits, ar ko to var izdarīt?
gloss: You must pay exactly €3.88 using euro coins only. What is the fewest coins? — 8: 2 € + 1 € + 50 + 20 + 10 + 5 + 2 + 1 cents.

text: Daugava ir garāka, taču tās izteka ir Krievijā. Kura ir garākā upe, kuras gan izteka, gan grīva atrodas Latvijā?
gloss: The Daugava is longer but rises in Russia. Which is the longest river with both source and mouth in Latvia? — The Gauja (452 km). The Venta rises in Lithuania; the Lielupe and Aiviekste are far shorter.

text: Augstu kalnos ūdens vārās krietni zem 100 °C, tāpēc kartupeļi tur jāvāra ilgāk. Kāpēc ūdens tur vārās zemākā temperatūrā?
gloss: High in the mountains water boils well below 100 °C. Why? — Lower air pressure. "Less oxygen" is true up there but irrelevant to boiling.

text: Vārds „robots” pirmo reizi izskanēja Karela Čapeka lugā, kas tapa 1920. gadā. No kuras valodas tas nāk?
gloss: The word "robot" first appeared in Karel Čapek's play written in 1920 (R.U.R.). Which language does it come from? — Czech (robota, "forced labour"); the writer's nationality is the clue.

text: Kurš no šiem notikumiem notika visagrāk?
gloss: Which of these happened first? — Gutenberg prints the Bible (c. 1455). Columbus 1492, Luther's theses 1517, Magellan sets out 1519.

text: Kurš pasaules šaha čempions sava aizraujošā uzbrukuma stila dēļ iesaukts par „burvi no Rīgas”?
gloss: Which world chess champion was nicknamed "the Magician from Riga" for his attacking style? — Mikhail Tal (champion 1960–61).

text: Basketbolu 1891. gadā izdomāja kanādietis Džeimss Neismits. Kurā valstī tas notika?
gloss: Basketball was invented in 1891 by the Canadian James Naismith. In which country? — The USA (Springfield, Massachusetts). His nationality is the trap.

text: Igaunijai tā ir bezdelīga, Lietuvai — baltais stārķis. Kurš putns ir Latvijas nacionālais putns?
gloss: Estonia's is the swallow, Lithuania's the white stork. Which is Latvia's national bird? — The white wagtail.

text: Kuru garšvielu iegūst no krokusa zieda drīksnām, un tāpēc tā ir viena no dārgākajām pasaulē?
gloss: Which spice comes from crocus stigmas and is therefore among the world's most expensive? — Saffron. Turmeric is a root, cinnamon a bark, vanilla an orchid pod.

text: Kuru seno ēģiptiešu dievu attēloja ar šakāļa galvu un saistīja ar mirušo apbedīšanu?
gloss: Which Egyptian god had a jackal's head and was linked with burying the dead? — Anubis. Horus and Ra are falcon-headed, Thoth ibis-headed.

text: Hercoga Jēkaba laikā Kurzemes hercogistei piederēja kolonija Karību jūrā. Kura sala tā bija?
gloss: Under Duke Jacob, the Duchy of Courland held a colony in the Caribbean. Which island? — Tobago (17th century; the duchy also held an island in the Gambia River).

text: Brīvības pieminekļa Milda tur trīs zvaigznes, kas simbolizē Latvijas novadus. Kuram novadam atsevišķas zvaigznes nav?
gloss: "Milda" on the Freedom Monument holds three stars for Latvia's regions. Which region has no star of its own? — Zemgale: the stars stand for Kurzeme, Vidzeme and Latgale (Zemgale was counted with Kurzeme).

text: Daudzas Rīgas jūgendstila ēkas projektēja arhitekts Mihails Eizenšteins. Viņa dēls kļuva par slavenu kinorežisoru. Kuru filmu uzņēma dēls?
gloss: Architect Mikhail Eisenstein designed many of Riga's Art Nouveau buildings; his son became a famous film director. Which film is the son's? — "Battleship Potemkin" (Sergei Eisenstein, born in Riga). Metropolis is Lang's, Nosferatu Murnau's, Man with a Movie Camera Vertov's.

text: QR kodu 1994. gadā izgudroja, lai rūpnīcās izsekotu automašīnu detaļas. Kurā valstī tas radās?
gloss: The QR code was invented in 1994 to track car parts in factories. In which country? — Japan (Denso Wave, a Toyota group company).

text: Žirafes kakls var būt gandrīz divus metrus garš. Cik tajā ir kakla skriemeļu?
gloss: A giraffe's neck can be nearly two metres long. How many neck vertebrae does it have? — Seven, the same as a human; each is just very long.

text: Kurš ir vismazākais kauls cilvēka ķermenī?
gloss: Which is the smallest bone in the human body? — The stapes (stirrup) in the middle ear; the hammer and anvil are its slightly larger neighbours, the pisiform a small wrist bone.

text: Kā skandināvu mitoloģijā sauca Odina astoņkājaino zirgu?
gloss: In Norse myth, what was Odin's eight-legged horse called? — Sleipnir. Grani is Sigurd's horse, Pegasus Greek, Bucephalus Alexander's.

text: Latvijas karogs ir 150 cm augsts. Cik plata ir tā baltā josla?
gloss: A Latvian flag is 150 cm tall. How wide is its white stripe? — 30 cm: the stripes are in the ratio 2:1:2, so white is 1/5 of the height. 50 cm assumes equal stripes.

text: Kurā no šīm galvaspilsētām ikdienā maksā ar eiro, lai gan valsts nav Eiropas Savienības dalībvalsts?
gloss: In which of these capitals do people pay in euros, though the country is not an EU member? — Podgorica: Montenegro uses the euro unilaterally. Serbia has the dinar, Albania the lek, North Macedonia the denar.

text: Kurš zinātnieks 1822. gadā pirmais atšifrēja ēģiptiešu hieroglifus, izmantojot Rozetas akmeni?
gloss: Who first deciphered Egyptian hieroglyphs in 1822 using the Rosetta Stone? — Jean-François Champollion. Thomas Young made early progress but did not decipher them; Carter found Tutankhamun, Schliemann dug Troy.

text: Rundāles pils arhitekts Sanktpēterburgā projektēja arī vienu no tās slavenākajām ēkām. Kuru?
gloss: The architect of Rundāle Palace also designed one of St Petersburg's most famous buildings. Which? — The Winter Palace (Francesco Bartolomeo Rastrelli). St Isaac's is Montferrand's, the Admiralty Zakharov's, Kazan Cathedral Voronikhin's.

text: „Divkārt iekšzemes” valsts robežojas tikai ar valstīm, kurām arī nav pieejas jūrai. Kura no šīm valstīm ir tāda?
gloss: A "doubly landlocked" country borders only landlocked countries. Which of these is one? — Liechtenstein: its only neighbours are Switzerland and Austria. Luxembourg borders France and Germany, which have coasts.

text: Kurā pilsētā mācītājs Ernsts Gliks 17. gadsimtā tulkoja Bībeli latviešu valodā? Tur vēl šodien aug Glika ozoli.
gloss: In which town did pastor Ernst Glück translate the Bible into Latvian in the 17th century? Glück's oaks still grow there. — Alūksne.

text: Visi šie monarhi valdīja vairāk nekā 60 gadu. Kurš no viņiem valdīja visilgāk?
gloss: All these monarchs reigned over 60 years. Who reigned longest? — Louis XIV (72 years, 1643–1715). Elizabeth II 70, Franz Joseph 68, Victoria 63.

text: Marija Kirī vienu no saviem atklātajiem elementiem nosauca dzimtenes vārdā. Kuru?
gloss: Marie Curie named one of the elements she discovered after her homeland. Which? — Polonium (Poland). All four are named after countries; francium is the trap for her French career.

text: Kurā Šekspīra lugā darbojas Kalibāns?
gloss: In which Shakespeare play does Caliban appear? — The Tempest.

text: Kurš komponists 19. gadsimta 30. gados bija diriģents Rīgas teātrī, bet bēgšana no Rīgas pa vētrainu jūru iedvesmoja viņa operu par spoku kuģi?
gloss: Which composer conducted at the Riga theatre in the 1830s, and whose stormy sea escape from Riga inspired his ghost-ship opera? — Richard Wagner (Riga 1837–39; The Flying Dutchman).

text: Latvijas izlase savu pirmo olimpisko zelta medaļu izcīnīja 2000. gadā Sidnejā. Kurā sporta veidā?
gloss: Latvia won its first Olympic gold in Sydney 2000. In which sport? — Artistic gymnastics: Igors Vihrovs, floor exercise.

text: Kuru miniatūru ierīci, ko vēlāk iecienīja spiegi, 1938. gadā sāka ražot Rīgas VEF rūpnīcā?
gloss: Which miniature device, later loved by spies, went into production at Riga's VEF factory in 1938? — A camera: Walter Zapp's Minox.

text: Kas īsti ir kaperi, ko pievieno mērcēm un salātiem?
gloss: What exactly are capers, added to sauces and salads? — Unopened flower buds of the caper bush, pickled or salted.
